conditions: The Circuit gives zero Pathos Clamps: it's relevant to Syam only as a Rune Marrow source.
Only the optional side Undercroft portals pay clamps; story-stage portals pay nothing.
Clamps ignore every Resource Booster, Drop Chance Booster, blessing and Retriever mod.
bonuses: Isleweaver never puts you in Drifter form, so your real Warframe and amp carry the mission regardless of the cave's randomized loadout.

Bank decrees on the non-combat objectives (Maw feeding, Komi, Shawzin, musical chests) before touching combat: free decrees that rescue a bad loadout, and Maw feeding is also where the 4 Maw Fang come from.

disclosures.title: Isleweaver alone isn't enough
disclosures.body: Maw Fang exists only in The Duviri Experience, not The Lone Story, not The Circuit, not Isleweaver. Farming all 50 clamps in Isleweaver leaves you unable to build the sword; run at least one full Duviri Experience with a Maw feeding.

groups.meta: unlocks the Drifter-usable Syam immediately and mails the Warframe-compatible blueprint
conditions: Acrithis does not sell Syam: her stock is Reactors, Catalysts, Adapters, Forma, Kuva and Rivens, not weapons.

rows.label: Syam
rows.note: 30,000 cr, 4 Maw Fang, 30 Rune Marrow, 30 Dracroot, 30 Eevani

conditions: Turn off "Camera Tracks Melee Target" in Gameplay settings first: the heavy-attack wave can't be aimed reliably with it on.
bonuses: Pairs with Kullervo or a subsumed Wrathful Advance for the crit-conversion wave-shred build; Lavos with its augment is the other named pairing.
